Content: Peppered moths, Biston betularia, exhibit light- and dark-color variations. Over the years `text(1950)-text(2000)`, changes to the trees inhabited by a population of peppered moths were observed.

In `text(1950)`, trees were primarily dark and covered in soot, as shown in Figure `1A`. In `text(2000)`, trees in the same areas were primarily light and covered in lichen, as shown in `1B`. Light- and dark-colored moths are shown on each tree.
Table `1` shows percentages of dark and light moths in the population from `text(1950)` to `text(2000)`.
Table `2` shows the survival percentages of dark and light moths in different environments.
